page.content:
Blatty's 1990 Gemini Killer sequel.

How The Exorcist III connects

  • Creator: William Peter Blatty — Blatty wrote and directed The Exorcist III.
  • Topic: The Exorcist — The Exorcist III continues Blatty's Georgetown story.
  • Character: Lieutenant Kinderman — Kinderman is the center of The Exorcist III.

What is The Exorcist III?

The Exorcist III, directed by Blatty from Legion, follows Kinderman through a Georgetown hospital and the Gemini Killer's return.

Key threads lead to William Peter Blatty, The Exorcist and Lieutenant Kinderman.
